name: Treshala Fallowbrook
summary: Treshala Fallowbrook is a night elf residing quietly on the upper level of the Tradesmen's Terrace in Darnassus. She is the wife of Heralath Fallowbrook, whose work has taken him far from home into the thorny depths of Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens.

sections.title: A Watcher on the Terrace
sections.body: Treshala Fallowbrook keeps a modest vigil on the second floor of a workshop in Darnassus's Tradesmen's Terrace. Her husband, Heralath, journeyed to the brambled depths of Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens, and she waits at home for word of him. The two are joined by a pendant of bonding, a keepsake of their marriage that Heralath carried with him into the quilboar's warrens.

faq.q: Where can I find Treshala Fallowbrook?
faq.answer: She is located on the second floor of a workshop in the Tradesmen's Terrace of Darnassus. You can reach her room by heading up the wooden interior ramp inside the weapons building.

She is not a researcher herself. The work belongs to her husband, Heralath Fallowbrook, whose journey took him into Razorfen Kraul; Treshala waits in Darnassus for news of him and of her pendant of bonding, which he carried there.

faq.q: Why is she concerned with Razorfen Kraul?
faq.answer: Her husband, Heralath, ventured into Razorfen Kraul, the thorny quilboar stronghold in the Barrens, and she has had no word of him since.

faq.q: Is she a shopkeeper or a craftswoman?
faq.answer: No, Treshala is neither a merchant nor a crafter. She simply makes her home above the busy artisan stalls of the Tradesmen's Terrace.

angles.text: For night elves, Treshala's quiet vigil for her husband is a reminder that since Mount Hyjal, their people no longer have eternity to wait.
Treshala serves as an Alliance point of contact in Darnassus for champions returning from harrowing expeditions against the quilboar thorn-dens deep in the Barrens.
